name: MINNESOTA STATE FAIRGROUNDS
status: Local compact native 2D fair accepted: real lower Pine Country walking gate, 255 exterior characters/35 trainers, three inhabited halls with seven room interactions, both lane projections and all six carpets. Four controller cases, two crowd cases, preservation/rejection and 377 audio checks pass. Full regional campaign/interior acceptance remains open.
identity: A fair to explore and do things in: a midway, livestock and 4-H barns, dairy exhibits, food stalls, a show ring and a fairground loop. Separate map, not a fair sign or one vendor in the city.
extent_policy: Fit the actual activities and readable native player cameras before freezing dimensions. Do not reserve a huge empty rectangle or shrink every activity into one plaza.

access.kind: Two-way woodland trail from the lower Pine Country road northwest of the metro.
access.anchor_status: Candidate native fair east/R05 west offsets+28/-28; nine exact pine cells open onto the existing road.
access.rail_connection: Walk from Minneapolis north onto Pine Country, then turn west. St Paul connects through the ordinary regional roads.
access.admission: No new mandatory main-story fee or rail-pass requirement. Optional shop purchases and game costs must be shown before spending.
access.progression: Optional regional destination. No badge, Q03 courier victory, Q06 depot flag, Safari permit or champion requirement is granted merely by entering.

districts.purpose: Recognizable gate, readable grounds map, information volunteer, fountain or planted meeting point and clear exits to both sides of the fair loop.

Distinct ride silhouettes, fenced queues, two native-script activities and a prize booth. All passable platforms must lead somewhere useful; moving ride presentation requires explicit Rust support and is not assumed to exist.
At least one fully enterable barn, a small show ring, regional creature/handler pairs and a 4-H learning activity. Pens have solid native fences, real gates and connected public viewing paths.

Enterable cold exhibit and butter-sculpture display tied to the existing Chislet/Buttermuse family. Dialogue or a demonstrator activity gives the exhibit a purpose; a building facade alone is insufficient.

Food-on-a-stick stalls, cookie stand and public picnic tables. Vendor menus use native inventory/money/shop behavior; do not scatter item balls as fake vendors. Doughlin/Crumcone/Pailbaron habitat follows the existing roster identities.

A visible trainer demonstration or optional small battle event, resting/seating space and a useful return connection to the entry. A grassy field must serve the ring or an encounter/activity rather than being avoidable filler.

activity_contracts.behavior: Three distinct stations: barn volunteer, dairy demonstrator and midway host. Native flags record each interaction. Prize clerk awards once only after all three; a full bag must leave the reward claim recoverable.
activity_contracts.status: Implemented in crowd-v2; production controller tests pass with state changes and persistence.

activity_contracts.behavior: Original regional creature question with native menu choices and dialogue branches. Show any cost first, allow B cancellation, and prevent retry spam from duplicating a once-only reward.
activity_contracts.status: Implemented in crowd-v2; production controller tests pass with state changes and persistence.

activity_contracts.behavior: Optional legal trainer party with visible invitation, native battle outcome, selected move PP changes and repeat dialogue. A win cannot stand in for a regional gym badge.
activity_contracts.status: Implemented in crowd-v2; production controller tests pass with state changes and persistence.

activity_contracts.behavior: Free native yes/no care question. One BERRY for a correct answer, full-bag retry and once-only flag; wrong answers can retry.
Staffed native counter restores party HP and PP through HealParty.
activity_contracts.status: Verified after actual show-ring battles through production input.

map_acceptance: Complete whole grounds render with every gate, district, pen, visible door and return loop; inspect actual160×144 approach and weakest routine segment.
Explicit native tile varieties distinguish midway, barns, dairy exhibit, food row and ring without prop scattering or wide vacant paving.
Connected roads and queues, ordinary return paths around any one-way ledges, physical fences/bollards and visible closure of reachable water boundaries.
Exact exterior DOOR quadrants, safe passive Floor arrivals and reciprocal room/gate exits; no decorative facade door promises.
Source collision and negative checks followed by native VisibleShellController entry/return, each activity, purchase/cancel, battle, reward-full-bag recovery and Save/Continue.
Retain every original render, rejected pass, source snapshot, conversion, crop, preview and native capture for reuse.

STATE FAIR
Northwest: MIDWAY and GRANDSTAND.
Northeast: FOOD PAVILION.
South: LIVESTOCK and DAIRY.
Grass habitats: bakery, dairy, midway, growers, orchard and hotdish. All food families visit!
Thirty-five trainers want a friendly battle. Visit first aid by the dairy.
Exit east for PINE COUNTRY and MINNEAPOLIS.
GRANDSTAND
The next show is inside.
LIVESTOCK BARN
Meet the handler and earn a stamp.
DAIRY EXHIBITION
Butter carving and the dairy stamp.
CURDLET, CHISLET and their evolved forms gather in the dairy grass.
MIGHTY MIDWAY
Free quiz and ring toss.
TILTAWISP and the PIPCORN family play in the nearby grass.
FOOD PAVILION
Eight cooks, one long counter.
DOUGHLIN grows into CRUMCONE, then PAILBARON. Search the grass behind the pavilion.
HORTICULTURE
Stroll the beds and meet the growers.
CRISPIP and the sugarbeet family grow in the orchard grass.

future_features: Animated ride silhouettes require separately reviewed native tile art and animation; large ImageGen rides are rejected.

expansion_contract.user_request: Bigger, more vendors, larger multitile structures, denser and more going on; raise the NPC limit rather than splitting the map.
expansion_contract.verification: PASS: 255 exterior actors, 35 trainers, source connectivity, original four patrol loops and Continue, new ambient movement/dialogue, Rust preservation/rebuild, 19 headless native views and 377 audio programs.

grass_contract.user_request: More grass patches; all existing food and fair Pokemon here.
grass_contract.scope: Food bodies, edible crop/grain families and State Fair carnival spirit; source roster only.

battle_contract.user_request: A lot of fairgoers want to battle; the state fair is chaos.
battle_contract.defeat_persistence: Native once-only defeated flags, after-battle dialogue and Save/Continue.
battle_contract.traversal: Crowded, overlapping sight lanes cross walking loops, queues and picnic courts. Vendor staff and physical counter approaches remain intact.
battle_contract.verification: PASS: all35 native battles with PP use, rewards and defeat flags; Continue retains defeat; overlapping midway challenges pass. Three controller cases complete177.75s.

crowd_contract.loops: 28 disjoint native-floor circuits: 12 slower walkers and 16 brisk runners. Normal collision, interaction pauses and native wait cadence apply.
crowd_contract.verification: PASS: source connectivity; all35 native battles; original four patrol loops and Continue; new walking/running/rotating movement and live dialogue; 19 headless native views; all377 audio programs.
crowd_contract.layout: Distributed small groups across food courts, midway, ring, garden, entry and projects. Clear sight corridors and exhibition pairs.
crowd_contract.kids_and_adults: Mixed youngsters, families, older visitors, exhibitors and judges; previous 7-kid/3-adult count describes the original ten-person addition.

beer.field_use: Carries confusion into the next battle; switching or ending battle clears it.
beer.refusal: No effect or consumption on full HP, fainted Pokemon, or eggs.

food_contract.verification_status: verified: all32 shop menus and16 food purchases, payment, healing and consumption; beer field/Continue/first aid and actual trainer-battle turn/confusion/clearing;78 core regressions
